safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure: c = a + b with overflow require
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b <= a, c = a - b
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure: c = a * b with overflow require
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b > 0, c = a / b
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership and onlyOwner checks
